result.summary: Skips the runtime environment locale verification in SetupEnvironment() when compiling for illumos-based platforms. This guards against upstream libstdc++ destructor crashes on illumos distributions during initialization.
result.problem: On illumos distributions (such as OmniOS or OpenIndiana) where GCC is configured with dragonfly locale support, destroying std::locale instances passes an uninitialized pointer to freelocale(). This causes bitcoind to intermittently crash on startup with memory errors when testing the environment locale.
evidence: PR description documents crashes with 'libc thread failure: lfree() called with a misaligned pointer' and cites upstream bug reports at illumos/gcc#56, omniosorg/omnios-build#4253, and illumos.org issue #18481.
result.scope_notes: A single-line preprocessor guard addition with explanatory comments in common/system.cpp.
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes; diff is now available.
result.card: Bypasses the environment locale validation check in SetupEnvironment() on illumos platforms. On illumos distributions where GCC uses dragonfly clocale support, destroying std::locale instances triggers an upstream bug where an uninitialized pointer is passed to freelocale(), causing intermittent startup crashes. The change stops bitcoind from crashing during startup on illumos systems without affecting other operating systems.

risk.why: A faulty preprocessor condition could skip locale fallback on other platforms or fail to suppress the crash on illumos.
